pages.quiz:
MUSIC AND DANCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World.
   B. Practise Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World.

2. Best practice when working on Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble.

3. Best practice when working on Instrumental Transpositions: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Instrumental Transpositions.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Instrumental Transpositions.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Instrumental Transpositions.
   D. Practise Instrumental Transpositions with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   C. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

5. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. Only the volume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. The ticket price

6. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Green, orange, and purple

7. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software.: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Music Notation Software. with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software..
   C. Damage equipment used for Music Notation Software..
   D. Disrupt classmates during Music Notation Software..

8. Best practice when working on Contemporary Songs from Kenya: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Contemporary Songs from Kenya with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Contemporary Songs from Kenya.
   C. Damage equipment used for Contemporary Songs from Kenya.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Contemporary Songs from Kenya.

9. Best practice when working on Four-Part Harmony: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Four-Part Harmony.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Four-Part Harmony.
   C. Practise Four-Part Harmony with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Four-Part Harmony.

10. Best practice when working on Dance Production: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Dance Production.
   B. Damage equipment used for Dance Production.
   C. Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Dance Production.

11. Best practice when working on Kenyan Contemporary Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Contemporary Songs.
   B. Practise Kenyan Contemporary Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Contemporary Songs.
   D. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Contemporary Songs.

12. Best practice when working on Western Ensembles: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Western Ensembles.
   B. Damage equipment used for Western Ensembles.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Western Ensembles.
   D. Practise Western Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Western Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Contemporary Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Practise Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. A — Practise Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. D — Practise Instrumental Transpositions with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. C — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. C — The speed of the music

6. A — Red, blue, and yellow

7. A — Practise Music Notation Software. with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. A — Practise Contemporary Songs from Kenya with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. C — Practise Four-Part Harmony with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. C — Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. B — Practise Kenyan Contemporary Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. D — Practise Western Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Western Instruments; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyan Contemporary Songs; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
